title: wide_range_slider_revision.md
content:
# Wide Range Slider Revision — 2026-06-25

This pass revises the NPC Voice Creator so the same friendly 0–10 sliders produce much stronger audible changes.

## Added visible sliders

- **Deep Register** — pushes the voice lower than the normal Voice Height slider, including subharmonic/body support.
- **Musical Lilt** — increases sing-song phrase arcs and melodic speaking movement.
- **Air Texture** — adds breath/whisper air as an audible texture instead of only making the voice softer.
- **Harsh Edge** — adds rasp, grit, bite, distortion, and broken edges.
- **Vocal Weight** — increases chest/body weight and heavier vocal mass.

## Retuned existing sliders

The existing sliders now have wider engine impact:

- **Voice Height** now spans roughly monster-low to bright/high instead of a mild middle band.
- **Body / Depth** and **Throat Depth** now strongly affect formants and low-register body.
- **Gruff Edge** now combines with Harsh Edge and Deep Register for growl and rasp.
- **Softness** combines with Air Texture for actual audible breath noise.
- **Expression Shape**, **Speech Rhythm**, and **Musical Lilt** create stronger pitch movement and phrase motion.

## Audio render changes

Local WAV rendering now includes:

- subharmonic oscillator layer for deeper voices;
- growl/flutter modulation for gruff voices;
- stronger airy high-noise layer;
- harsher consonant bursts and rasp when Harsh Edge is high;
- stronger lilt/phrase arcs;
- output normalization so extreme slider combinations do not just clip.

## Export/contract changes

The hidden acapella/export bridge and Python manifest pipeline now include the same wide-impact parameters and report `rangeVersion: wide-impact-v3` in generated JSON/runtime data.

## Old math use

The uploaded old math files were preserved under `docs/reference/old-voice-math/`. The current implementation borrows the useful concepts from the old source/filter, formant, prosody, and humanization math, but keeps the active app lighter and static-friendly.
